_help.flightBase: The least time any thrown seed flies, even on a short throw. Higher = slower, floatier throws. The per-hex setting below adds more for long throws. Try 0.2–0.5.
_help.flightPerHex: Added for each hex the seed flies over, so long throws take longer. 0 = every throw takes the same time. Try 0.03–0.08.
_help.arcHeight: Higher = a taller, loopier arc; 0 = it flies flat. It grows with the throw's length, so long throws arc higher. Try 0.2–0.5.
_help.seedSize: How big the seed looks in the air. 0.3 = about a third of a hex. Try 0.2–0.4.
_help.hopHeight: The little jump the glyphling does as it throws. Higher = a bigger jump; 0 = no hop. Try 0.15–0.35.
_help.hopTime: Higher = a slower, floatier hop; lower = a quick flick. Try 0.12–0.25.
_help.growTime: How long the seed takes to grow up out of the ground once it lands. Higher = a slower bloom. Try 0.3–0.8.
_help.growFrom: How big the sprout is at the very start. Low = it grows from a tiny dot (more dramatic); 1 = it starts full size (no grow). Try 0.05–0.3.
_help.pulseTime: The ring round a piece you have planned but not confirmed (a moved glyphling, an aimed seed and its tray slot) blinks bright → faint → bright. Higher = a slower, calmer blink. (The end-of-game tangled blink has its own speed: End reveal.) Try 0.8–2.
_help.wordGlowTime: How long after a seed lands the garden stays clear before the handoff box or the end-of-game reveal may cover it, when the cast scores nothing (or word indicators are off), in seconds. A cast that scores waits for its whole score sequence instead.
_help.spotlightHold: Word spotlight, while aiming: when the aimed seed would make 2 or more words, they light up ONE at a time (QUA +4 → TAB +5 → round again). This is how long each word stays lit, in seconds. (One word just stays lit.) After Cast the words score in this same order — see the Score sequence.
_help.spotlightFade: Word spotlight: how long each word takes to fade in and to fade out, in seconds — while aiming, and as each word takes its turn in the score sequence. The next word starts after the last one has faded, so only one is ever lit. Reduce motion = no fade (the words just step).
_help.revealTangles: At the end, the tangled glyphlings blink before any bonus shows. Higher = a longer build-up; 0 = straight to the bonuses. Try 1–2.
_help.tangleBlinkTime: At the end, how fast the tangled glyphlings blink, in seconds per blink. Higher = a slower, heavier blink. (How long they blink before the bonuses: the setting above.) Try 0.8–2.
_help.revealBonus: The "+3" tangle bonuses pop on rival pieces one hex at a time; this is the time each one gets. Higher = a slower count. (How bouncy each pop is: the pop-in time below.) Try 0.4–0.8.
_help.revealCount: Each player's Magic counts up in turn, lowest first, with a short pause after. Higher = more suspense. Try 1–2.
_help.revealWinner: How long the winner banner stays before the end table opens. Higher = more time to celebrate. Try 2–3.
_help.revealPopTime: Each "+3" swells past full size, then settles. Higher = a slower, softer pop; lower = snappier. (The gap between bonuses is a separate setting above.) Try 0.3–0.5.
_help.moveBase: The least time a glyphling takes to glide to its new hex, even one hex away. Higher = slower moves. The per-hex setting below adds more for long moves. Try 0.1–0.25.
_help.movePerHex: Added for each hex it crosses, so long moves take longer. 0 = every move takes the same time. Try 0.02–0.06.
_help.moveSettle: How far a gliding glyphling overshoots its new hex before settling back. Higher = a bouncier stop; 0 = it stops dead. Try 0.03–0.1.
_help.scorePopDelay: Score sequence (word indicators on): seconds after a seed lands before the first word starts scoring.
_help.scoreWordTime: Score sequence: the words score ONE AT A TIME (outline + word bubble, its seeds pop their points, the points fly to the glyphling). This is the time each word gets, in seconds — a long word may take a little longer, because the next word waits until its last point has arrived in the total.
_help.scorePopGap: Score sequence: seconds between one seed's "+1" / "+2" popping and the next (they ripple along the word) — and between one point arriving in the glyphling's total and the next.
_help.scorePopTime: Score sequence: how long one "+1" / "+2" takes to pop in over its seed (grow past full size and settle), in seconds. The glyphling's total pops this fast too each time points arrive.
_help.scorePopHold: Score sequence: how long a word's pops stay over its seeds before they fly to the glyphling, in seconds.
_help.scoreFlyTime: Score sequence: how long each point takes to fly from its seed into the glyphling's running total, in seconds.
_help.scoreTotalHold: Score sequence: after the last word, how long the final total ("+12") and the last word stay before fading, in seconds.
_help.scoreTotalFade: Score sequence: how long the final total, the last word's outline and its bubble take to fade away, in seconds. Only then does the next turn (or the handoff box) start.
_help.scoreTotalGrow: Score sequence: how much bigger the glyphling's running total gets for every point that flies in (0.05 = 5% per point), so a big turn ends with a big number. Capped by Total: biggest size.
_help.scoreTotalMaxGrow: Score sequence: the most the running total can grow, so huge turns stay on the board (0.8 = up to 80% bigger than its starting size).
_help.turnPulseTime: At the start of a turn the current player's glyphlings slowly swell and shrink until one is moved. Higher = slower, calmer breathing. How much they swell: Juice sizes. Try 1–2.5.
_help.noShakeTime: Tap something you can't move and it gives a quick sideways shake. Higher = a slower, longer shake. How far it moves: Juice sizes. Try 0.25–0.5.
_help.refreshShrinkTime: After a Refresh, each set-aside seed shrinks out of the tray. Higher = a slower shrink. Try 0.15–0.4.
_help.refreshGrowTime: Each new seed grows into its tray slot, swells a little past full size and settles. Higher = a slower grow. How far it swells: Juice sizes. Try 0.25–0.5.
_help.refreshStagger: The slots shrink and grow one after another, left to right. Higher = a slower ripple across the tray; 0 = all at once. Try 0.04–0.12.
_help.refreshPause: The beat after the last old seed shrinks away and before the new ones grow in. Higher = a longer empty moment. Play passes on only once the new seeds have grown. Try 0.05–0.25.
_help.trailLead: When another player's turn is replayed online, their trail (rings and dotted path) draws on over this long before their glyphling glides. Higher = slower and easier to follow. Reduce motion = it just appears. Try 0.3–0.8.
_help.trailHold: How long the finished trail stays still before the glide and throw play. Higher = more time to see where they are going. Together with the draw-on time, this is how much slower each replayed turn is. Try 0.2–0.6.

_labels.flightBase: Thrown seed: time in the air, every throw (seconds)
_labels.flightPerHex: Thrown seed: extra air time per hex it travels (seconds)
_labels.arcHeight: Thrown seed: how high it arcs
_labels.hopHeight: Glyphling: hop height as it throws (hexes)
_labels.hopTime: Glyphling: how long the throwing hop lasts (seconds)
_labels.growTime: Runeblossom: time to grow after the seed lands (seconds)
_labels.growFrom: Runeblossom: size it starts growing from (0–1)
_labels.movePerHex: Glyphling: extra glide time per hex it travels (seconds)
_labels.moveSettle: Glyphling: bounce past its new hex (hexes)
_labels.wordGlowTime: After a seed lands: pause before anything covers the board (seconds)
_labels.spotlightHold: Word spotlight: time each word stays lit (seconds)
_labels.spotlightFade: Word spotlight: fade time as it moves between words (seconds)
_labels.trailLead: Turn trail: time to draw itself on, online replays (seconds)
_labels.trailHold: Turn trail: pause once it is drawn, online replays (seconds)
_labels.turnPulseTime: Whose turn: how slowly the glyphlings breathe (seconds per breath)
_labels.refreshShrinkTime: Refresh: time each old seed takes to shrink away (seconds)
_labels.refreshGrowTime: Refresh: time each new seed takes to grow in (seconds)
_labels.refreshStagger: Refresh: gap between one tray slot and the next (seconds)
_labels.refreshPause: Refresh: empty-tray pause between old seeds and new (seconds)
_labels.revealTangles: End reveal: how long tangled glyphlings blink first (seconds)
_labels.tangleBlinkTime: End reveal: tangled glyphlings' blink speed (seconds)
_labels.revealBonus: End reveal: gap between one "+3" bonus and the next (seconds)
_labels.revealCount: End reveal: time for each player's Magic to count up (seconds)
_labels.revealWinner: End reveal: how long "Grand Glyphtender!" shows (seconds)
_labels.revealPopTime: End reveal: how long each "+3" takes to pop in (seconds)
